PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces the jump drive effect with a black smoke teleport
PluginData.Description:
Replaces the jump drive effect with a black smoke teleport.
A cloud of black smoke with violet lightning gathers around the ship during the countdown and hides it before the jump. The cloud stays behind and breaks up, and the ship comes out inside the same smoke at the other end. An aborted jump tears the cloud apart. The smoke stays out of pressurized rooms, so from inside the ship you see it only through the windows.
The jump has new sounds, and the music goes quieter while a jump is heard. The colours, the size of the clouds and the music level are settings. Client side only: you see every jump near you, whether or not the other players have the plugin.
